rules.structure: one block-final word per language for the block 3 «Asia» review; Challenge GeoWords reuse the approved review words of block 3 sections 1-8
rules.approval: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {answer, definition}
rules.definitions: a definition never contains its answer word, nor a word of the same root (no «много», «образ», «diverse»)

en.definition: A great variety of things that are not alike, side by side: landscapes, peoples, languages and customs. Asia is a striking example, from taiga and rainforest to deserts and the highest mountains on Earth.

ru.definition: Огромное число разных, непохожих друг на друга видов, форм и явлений рядом: природных зон, народов, языков, обычаев. Азия — яркий пример: тайга и тропические леса, пустыни и высочайшие горы Земли.
